rationale: Price is grinding sideways in an extremely tight range (ATR $0.03 on 5-min) with sharply declining volume on the last two candles, offering no mechanical entry signal in either direction. The instrument is sitting at 14% of today's range near the daily low, well below both the 5-min VWAP ($20.60) and session VWAP ($21.30), which favors continuation of the downtrend, but the near-zero momentum and absence of any catalytic news make a low-risk entry point impossible to define with confidence. Spread is tight but the lack of directional conviction and negligible candle range produce insufficient risk/reward to justify capital deployment.
